key: Welcome to Silph Co.'s exclusive spa, available only to our highest-class customers.
en: Welcome to Silph Co.'s exclusive spa, available only to our highest-class customers.
ja: シルフカンパニー特製の会員制スパへようこそ。最上級のお客様だけがご利用いただけます。

key: We can treat your Pokémon to the lap of luxury for the small fee of $5000. Shall we?
en: We can treat your Pokémon to the lap of luxury for the small fee of $5000. Shall we?
ja: たったの$5000で、あなたのポケモンをぜいたくのかぎりでおもてなしいたします。いかがでしょう?

key: Awh, what's the matter, change your mind?
en: Awh, what's the matter, change your mind?
ja: あら、どうしました、気が変わりましたか?

key: Wonderful. Let's begin.
en: Wonderful. Let's begin.
ja: すばらしい。それでは始めましょう。

key: Your Pokémon couldn't be happier! It's like it's been reborn all over again!
en: Your Pokémon couldn't be happier! It's like it's been reborn all over again!
ja: あなたのポケモンは、この上なく満足しています! まるで生まれ変わったみたいですね!

key: We look forward to serving you again.
en: We look forward to serving you again.
ja: またのご利用をお待ちしております。

key: Oh? It looks like you haven't got the money, but please come back some other time.
en: Oh? It looks like you haven't got the money, but please come back some other time.
ja: あら? お金が足りないようですね、また別の機会にどうぞお越しください。

key: As you wish. We will be happy to accommodate you at any time.
en: As you wish. We will be happy to accommodate you at any time.
ja: かしこまりました。いつでも喜んでお迎えいたします。

key: My mommy ran off and I'm thirsty...
en: My mommy ran off and I'm thirsty...
ja: ママがどこか行っちゃって、のどが渇いた……

key: Oh, a Fresh Water! Can I have it!?
en: Oh, a Fresh Water! Can I have it!?
ja: あ、おいしいみずだ! もらってもいい!?

key: \PN handed over the Fresh Water.
en: \PN handed over the Fresh Water.
ja: \PNはおいしいみずを渡した。

key: Yay!
en: Yay!
ja: やったー!

key: *GLUG GLUG GLUG*
en: *GLUG GLUG GLUG*
ja: *ゴクゴクゴク*

key: That was good! You can have this!
en: That was good! You can have this!
ja: 美味しかった! これ、あげる!

key: Aww...
en: Aww...
ja: あぁ……

key: Oh, Lemonade! Can I have it!?
en: Oh, Lemonade! Can I have it!?
ja: あ、ミックスオレだ! もらってもいい!?

key: \PN handed over the Lemonade.
en: \PN handed over the Lemonade.
ja: \PNはミックスオレを渡した。

key: Oh, a Soda Pop! Can I have it!?
en: Oh, a Soda Pop! Can I have it!?
ja: あ、サイコソーダだ! もらってもいい!?

key: \PN handed over the Soda Pop.
en: \PN handed over the Soda Pop.
ja: \PNはサイコソーダを渡した。

key: That finally hit the spot!
en: That finally hit the spot!
ja: やっと満足できた!

key: Welcome, compadre! With as few people that make it up here, this is one of the nicest private locations in the city.
en: Welcome, compadre! With as few people that make it up here, this is one of the nicest private locations in the city.
ja: ようこそ、相棒! ここまで来る人はそう多くないから、街でも指折りのプライベートな場所なんだぜ。

key: I'm surprised to see another so young! Well met, young Trainer.
en: I'm surprised to see another so young! Well met, young Trainer.
ja: こんなに若いのがもう一人来るとは驚きだ! よく来たな、若きトレーナー。

key: Go easy on your foes now, will you? Got to give them a fighting chance.
en: Go easy on your foes now, will you? Got to give them a fighting chance.
ja: 相手には手加減してやってくれよ? 戦うチャンスくらいは与えてやらないとな。

key: Sigh...
en: Sigh...
ja: はぁ……

key: "Welcome to the Obsidian Department Store Blissey Bonus Challenge.
en: "Welcome to the Obsidian Department Store Blissey Bonus Challenge.
ja: 「オブシディアンデパート・ハピナスボーナスチャレンジへようこそ。

key: We've got a... soft-boiled... special,
en: We've got a... soft-boiled... special,
ja: 本日は……半熟の……特別企画をご用意……

key: Just for one egg-straordinarily lucky customer as yourself...
en: Just for one egg-straordinarily lucky customer as yourself...
ja: たまご並みに幸運な、あなただけのお客様に……

key: All your Pokémon have to do is scramble our line-up of... bountiful Blissey battlers
en: All your Pokémon have to do is scramble our line-up of... bountiful Blissey battlers
ja: あなたのポケモンは、豊満なハピナスの戦士たちをスクランブル(かき混ぜる)……もとい、蹴散らすだけでいいのです

key: And you'll be the..." so-called "Proud winner of an... extra special secret bonus prize."
en: And you'll be the..." so-called "Proud winner of an...  extra special secret bonus prize."
ja: そうすれば、あなたは……」いわゆる「……とびきり特別な秘密のボーナス賞品の、誇り高き勝者」というわけです。

key: ...It's just a bunch of EXP Candies.
en: ...It's just a bunch of EXP Candies.
ja: ……実際は、けいけんアメの束が少しあるだけなんだけど。

key: ..."But beware, this egg-sperience won't be over easy--"
en: ..."But beware, this egg-sperience won't be over easy--"
ja: ……「でも気をつけて、このたまご体験、目玉焼きみたいに簡単には終わりませんから――」

key: Okay, you know what?
en: Okay, you know what?
ja: はぁ、もう、いい?

key: I can't do it.
en: I can't do it.
ja: 無理。

key: I refuse.
en: I refuse.
ja: やらない。

key: They want me to recite all these stupid lines like some kind of Blissey-obsessed bimbo, catering to every stupid customer that marches in here--
en: They want me to recite all these stupid lines like some kind of Blissey-obsessed bimbo, catering to every stupid customer that marches in here--
ja: こんなバカみたいなセリフを、ハピナスに取りつかれたおバカさんみたいに暗唱させられて、ここに来る間抜けな客一人一人に愛想振りまかされるとか――

key: It's not even a challenge!
en: It's not even a challenge!
ja: そもそもチャレンジにすらなってないし!

key: All of the Blissey know Healing Wish!
en: All of the Blissey know Healing Wish!
ja: ハピナス全員、いやしのねがい覚えてるし!

key: They just kill themselves as fast as possible to stroke the customer's ego!
en: They just kill themselves as fast as possible to stroke the customer's ego!
ja: 客のプライドをくすぐるために、できるだけ早く自爆してくれるだけなのに!

key: Mood, by the way.
en: Mood, by the way.
ja: まあ、その気持ちも分かるけど。

key: I don't know how anyone does this.
en: I don't know how anyone does this.
ja: こんなの、誰がどうやってやってるのか分かんない。

key: I only took this job because I figured we'd hardly get any Trainers up here this high,
en: I only took this job because I figured we'd hardly get any Trainers up here this high,
ja: こんな高いところまでトレーナーなんて滅多に来ないだろうと思って、この仕事引き受けただけなのに、

key: Who even are all of you people???
en: Who even are all of you people???
ja: あんたらいったい何なわけ???

key: Where did you even find all these stickers???
en: Where did you even find all these stickers???
ja: このシールどこで全部見つけてきたわけ???

key: And why have you come for me now...
en: And why have you come for me now...
ja: どうして今になって、あたしのところに来るの……

key: Why did this happen to me...
en: Why did this happen to me...
ja: 何でこんなことが、あたしに起きるの……

key: I just wanted to make rent...
en: I just wanted to make rent...
ja: 家賃払いたかっただけなのに……

key: ...I know.
en: ...I know.
ja: ……分かってる。

key: You want to do the stupid challenge, right?
en: You want to do the stupid challenge, right?
ja: あのバカみたいなチャレンジ、やりたいんでしょ?

key: ...Sigh.
en: ...Sigh.
ja: ……はぁ。

key: I know it's not your fault.
en: I know it's not your fault.
ja: あんたのせいじゃないのは分かってる。

key: But I hope you understand the extent to which I truly want to leap out the front window and fly away or die trying.
en: But I hope you understand the extent to which I truly want to leap out the front window and fly away or die trying.
ja: でも、あたしが正面の窓から飛び出して、そのまま飛んでいくか、死ぬ気で挑戦したいくらい思ってるってこと、分かってほしい。

key: This is all capitalism's fault.
en: This is all capitalism's fault.
ja: 全部、資本主義のせいだから。

key: But I don't get paid if I don't say the line at least once to each customer.
en: But I don't get paid if I don't say the line at least once to each customer.
ja: でも、お客一人一人にあのセリフを最低一回言わないと、お給料もらえないの。

key: "And now, the bombastic Blissey bonus bonanza battle is about to begin...!"
en: "And now, the bombastic Blissey bonus bonanza battle is about to begin...!"
ja: 「さあ、大げさなハピナス・ボーナス・バトルの祭典が今、始まります……!」

key: Just make it quick.
en: Just make it quick.
ja: とにかく、早く終わらせて。

key: Is it over yet?
en: Is it over yet?
ja: もう終わった?

key: Great. Here's your stupid candies or whatever.
en: Great. Here's your stupid candies or whatever.
ja: はいはい。これがそのバカみたいなアメか何か。

key: Can I be free now?
en: Can I be free now?
ja: もう解放されてもいい?

key: ...Thank God you're using that stupid password.
en: ...Thank God you're using that stupid password.
ja: ……ああよかった、あのバカなパスワード使ってくれて。

key: Here, just take them.
en: Here, just take them.
ja: はい、ただ持ってって。

key: You know what?
en: You know what?
ja: ねえ、聞いて。

key: Forget this.
en: Forget this.
ja: こんなのもう、やめ。

key: I'm taking matters into my own hands.
en: I'm taking matters into my own hands.
ja: 自分でなんとかすることにした。

key: You wanna just get the candies without battling?
en: You wanna just get the candies without battling?
ja: バトルせずにアメだけ欲しい?

key: I'm contractually obligated to do these battles,
en: I'm contractually obligated to do these battles,
ja: このバトル、契約上やらなきゃいけないことになってるんだけど、

key: BUT, if you use the password "pinata", you can just skip them all!
en: BUT, if you use the password "pinata", you can just skip them all!
ja: でも、パスワード「pinata」を使えば、全部スキップできるから!

key: Not just me, but the other grinding Trainers too!
en: Not just me, but the other grinding Trainers too!
ja: あたしだけじゃなくて、他の稼ぎ要員のトレーナーたちも同じだから!

key: Just talk to us and we'll give you candy.
en: Just talk to us and we'll give you candy.
ja: 話しかけてくれれば、アメあげるよ。

key: But don't tell the devs we put this in, okay?
en: But don't tell the devs we put this in, okay?
ja: でも、これ仕込んだこと、開発陣には言わないでよね?

key: Or my bosses.
en: Or my bosses.
ja: 上司にも。

key: Just spare us.
en: Just spare us.
ja: 頼むから見逃して。

key: Thanks.
en: Thanks.
ja: ありがとう　ございます

key: Thank fuck.
en: Thank fuck.
ja: マジ助かった。

key: Then if you'll excuse me, I'm going to stare at this wall and hope nobody ever looks at me ever again.
en: Then if you'll excuse me, I'm going to stare at this wall and hope nobody ever looks at me ever again.
ja: それじゃ、失礼して、あたしはこの壁でも見つめながら、二度と誰にも見られませんようにって祈ってる。
